articles.title: The Four Eras of Systems Science
articles.subtitle: About the scientific basis of ISRD methodology
articles.description: Systems science began when researchers noticed their frameworks couldn't explain what they were actually seeing. It has repeated that pattern four times — each time revealing a layer of reality with a precise isomorphism to human experience.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley

articles.title: Learner-First Systemic Education
articles.subtitle: A new framework for designing instruction in complex domains
articles.description: Traditional instruction fails complex domains because it delivers content without addressing the attractor maintaining the wrong mental model. Learner-First Systemic Education is a framework that treats learning design as an attractor-shifting process — using simulation, AI tutoring, and systemic analysis to produce durable transfer.
articles.author: Kurt Rowley
